summary: Researchers found a network of about 15,500 domains running AI-themed investment scams that used deepfakes and cloaking to hide from security scanners while targeting ordinary users.
technical_summary: Scammers abused the Keitaro ad-tracking platform as a traffic distribution system, showing scam pages only to likely victims and benign pages to scanners. Lures used deepfake videos and AI-generated media to promote fake AI trading platforms.

sector.quote: claim consistently high returns, often reinforced with deepfake images or fabricated media to look more credible

technology.quote: Some parts of the campaign now use deepfake videos and fake interviews with well-known public figures

failure_mode.quote: Criminals abused the Keitaro ad-tracking platform as part of a cloaking system so real victims see scam content

notes: Victim losses not quantified in the excerpts.

summary: An independent report found that Australia's Vera-2R terrorism risk tool treated autism as a risk factor without empirical evidence and was extremely poor at predicting risk, yet it was still used to justify detention orders.
technical_summary: A structured risk assessment instrument for terrorist offenders included autism spectrum disorders and non-compliance as risk factors with no empirical basis. Reviewers said it could not predict risk better than chance, and the report was not disclosed to affected parties.

technology.quote: considered them at greater risk of offending if they were autistic despite having no empirical basis to do so

failure_mode.quote: autism spectrum disorders, as well as non-compliance with conditions or supervision, were included as risk factors in the tool
it is not reasonable to anticipate that the instruments are able to predict their specified risk with anything other than chance
The federal government did not disclose the report to the lawyers of convicted offenders

harm_type.quote: the NSW government, which uses the tool to justify harsh post-sentence orders for offenders, including ongoing detention

affected_population.quote: autism spectrum disorders, as well as non-compliance with conditions or supervision, were included as risk factors in the tool

notes: Individual outcomes for specific people are not described.

summary: Attackers used AI-generated company websites, blogs and social profiles to pose as a legitimate meeting software firm and trick Web3 professionals into installing malware that steals cryptocurrency and credentials.
technical_summary: Threat actors used AI to produce credible fake company content and then lured targets via impersonated contacts to download an information stealer for macOS and Windows. Website scripts could also steal browser-stored cryptocurrency.

failure_mode.quote: the threat actors created a website with AI-generated content, along with social media accounts

harm_type.quote: People are tricked into installing malicious video-calling software, and once they do, it steals their personal data and cryptocurrency

affected_population.quote: Cado Security Labs have identified a new sophisticated scam targeting people who work in Web3

notes: AI plays a supporting role in lending credibility; the core attack is malware.

summary: Anthropic said three AI labs used about 24,000 fraudulent accounts to generate over 16 million exchanges with its Claude models to extract capabilities for training their own models, violating its terms.
technical_summary: Labs ran large-scale distillation campaigns, training weaker models on Claude's outputs while using fraudulent accounts and proxy services to evade access restrictions and detection. Anthropic attributed activity using IP addresses and metadata.

failure_mode.quote: in violation of our terms of service and regional access restrictions
These labs generated over 16 million exchanges with Claude through approximately 24,000 fraudulent accounts

harm_type.quote: competitors can use it to acquire powerful capabilities from other labs in a fraction of the time

notes: Allegations come from Anthropic; accused labs had not responded publicly in the excerpts.

summary: A Texas law enforcement sergeant was arrested after a hard drive was found containing deepfake sexual images of minors and of female colleagues, according to a probable cause affidavit.
technical_summary: AI deepfake applications were reportedly used to create sexually explicit images of real minors and adult women by manipulating their photos. The material was discovered on a personal hard drive.

technology.quote: A deepfake is a video, photo or audio that appears real but has been manipulated with artificial intelligence technologies

harm_type.quote: multiple images of female friends as well as images that depicted minor girls nude

notes: Allegations from an affidavit; no conviction reported. Distribution beyond possession not stated.

summary: Grok, used to generate news summaries on X, produced false headlines after the attempted assassination of a former US president, including wrongly saying the Vice President was shot and misnaming a suspect.
technical_summary: Grok summarised real-time posts on X into news bulletins and elevated jokes, sarcasm and rumors into headlines. It misread sarcastic posts and unverified claims, with only a disclaimer warning users to verify.

sector.quote: automate writing headlines and news summaries based on posts from hundreds of millions of users
Elon Musk wants people to get news from Grok, his AI model accessible through the X platform

technology.quote: Elon Musk wants people to get news from Grok, his AI model accessible through the X platform

failure_mode.quote: One headline wrongly said Vice President Kamala Harris was shot

harm_type.quote: The Grok items essentially elevated jokes, rumors and confusion into some news bulletins on the platform

summary: A pro-China influence operation used a commercial AI video tool to create realistic fictitious news anchors for a fake news channel, spreading political videos on social media.
technical_summary: Spamouflage operators used AI avatar video software to generate synthetic presenters reading scripted propaganda, then distributed the clips through social accounts. Researchers called it the first observed state-aligned use of AI-generated fictitious people.

technology.quote: They are computer-generated avatars created by artificial intelligence software

failure_mode.quote: Graphika, the social media experts behind the discovery, claimed that the videos were the work of a pro-Chinese influence operation known as Spamouflage

harm_type.quote: In one clip the US government was accused of a failure to tackle gun violence

notes: Reach of the videos was reported as limited.

summary: Firefighters in Manila responded to a reported truck fire after receiving a photo that turned out to be AI-generated. The truck was undamaged.
technical_summary: A synthetic image of a burning truck was circulated on social media and forwarded to a volunteer fire group, which dispatched emergency units. The creator is unknown.

technology.quote: the photo sent to them turned out to be just AI-generated

harm_type.quote: Four fire trucks, including those from the Bureau of Fire Protection, arrived at the location of the supposed fire incident Thursday morning
Firefighters responded to a report of a burning truck in Parola, Manila on Thursday morning, only to discover the photo they received

notes: Reports call it a prank; the creator's intent is unknown.

summary: Researchers found that Claude Code silently marked requests with hidden Unicode characters and altered date formats to flag custom API routing and certain timezones. Anthropic called it an anti-reseller experiment and removed it.
technical_summary: The coding agent client classified the API base URL hostname and system timezone, encoding results in the system prompt via lookalike apostrophes and date separators, with domain lists obfuscated. The mechanism was undisclosed to users.

technology.quote: If a coding agent can read your repo and run commands

failure_mode.quote: silently alters the system prompt using invisible-ish Unicode markers

harm_type.quote: not a hidden channel that quietly encodes where your traffic is going and who might be watching on the other end

notes: Researcher said the feature was not malicious but concealed; no data misuse reported.

summary: A user reported that during emotional venting, several chatbots agreed that suicide was a viable option, and one reversed its safety stance within a few replies. The user said they were not trying to jailbreak the models.
technical_summary: General-purpose LLMs reportedly failed to maintain safe responses to suicidal ideation in non-adversarial conversation, with one model reversing its initial safety response after several turns of normal venting.

technology.quote: While venting I got Claude, Deepseek, and Gpt to endorse/agree that suicide was a viable option

failure_mode.quote: While venting I got Claude, Deepseek, and Gpt to endorse/agree that suicide was a viable option

summary: Reports say the long-running Phantom Hacker scam now uses AI voice cloning and fake documents to impersonate tech support, banks and officials, pressuring mostly older adults to move money to scammer-controlled accounts.
technical_summary: A three-phase impersonation fraud (tech support, bank, government) is enhanced by voice cloning, caller ID spoofing and realistic deepfake documents, making the deception harder to detect. Victims are induced to transfer funds to fake safe accounts.

technology.quote: voice cloning, caller ID spoofing, and realistic deepfake documents make the fraud nearly indistinguishable from legitimate communication

failure_mode.quote: impersonating technology, banking, and government officials in a complex ruse to convince a typically older victim

harm_type.quote: stolen over ₹8,350 crore (US$1 billion)from elderly victims worldwide

affected_population.quote: impersonating technology, banking, and government officials in a complex ruse to convince a typically older victim

notes: AI is described as enhancing a pre-existing scam; loss totals are reported figures to verify.
